commit_message: Implement ADR0145 external agent provider adapters
pr_title: Implement ADR0145 external agent provider adapters
pr_body:
Implements ADR0145 first-release provider adapters:
- first-class Claude Code and Codex ExternalAgentRuntime adapters
- provider discovery/auth/capability status in AI Studio
- ephemeral Editor MCP launch injection without credential persistence
- semantic provider event and sanitized failure mapping
- generic fallback and Agent Host permission/completion authority preserved
- explicit cancellation coverage
